title: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call on July 23, 2026
summary: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ESQ) (the "Company"), the financial holding company for Esquire Bank, National Association ("Esquire Bank" or the "Bank"), (collectively "Esquire") today announced that the Company will release earnings for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 on Thursday, July 23, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. (ET). The Company will conduct a conference call on Thursday, July 23, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (ET), during which Andrew C. Sagliocca, Vice Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President, and Michael Lacapria, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will discuss Esquire's second quarter financial performance, followed by a question-and-answer period. The live audio webcast can be accessed via the following link: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/221060674 Corresponding presentation slides and a replay of the conference call will be available on Esquire's Investor Relations web page at investorrelations.esquirebank.com .
